signals.title: Puppet Show: Chirpy the Sparrow (Косе Босе)
signals.location: Konstantin Velichkov Drama and Puppet Theatre, Pazardzhik
signals.reason: An engaging, classic Bulgarian animal puppet play tailored for preschoolers, located an easy 35-minute drive from Plovdiv and easily combined with Pazardzhik Island Park.

signals.title: Premiere: The Three Brothers and the Golden Apple (Тримата братя и златната ябълка)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre, 46 General Gurko Str., Stara Zagora
signals.reason: A brand-new premiere of a classic fairy tale filled with puppets, magical staging, and gentle storytelling, easily paired with Stara Zagora Zoo for a full day trip.

signals.title: Puppet Show: Patilansko Tsarstvo (Патиланско царство)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre, 46 General Gurko Str., Stara Zagora
signals.reason: An energetic, cheerful stage adaptation of beloved Bulgarian childhood adventures that a 4-year-old can easily follow and enjoy.

signals.title: Opening of Christmas in Plovdiv Winter Festival & Market
signals.reason: The grand opening of the festive village featuring a genuine two-story European carousel, dry-slope sledding slides, and wide pedestrian walkways ideal for a 4-year-old.

signals.title: Night of Theatres: The Emperor's New Clothes (Новите дрехи на царя)
signals.reason: A special daylight family performance of Andersen's classic tale staged right in Plovdiv as part of the nationwide European Night of Theatres.

signals.title: Puppet Show: Chirpy the Sparrow (Косе Босе)
signals.location: State Puppet Theatre Plovdiv, 14 Hristo G. Danov Str., Plovdiv
signals.reason: A gentle, colorful morning puppet performance designed for young children ages 3+ right in central Plovdiv.

signals.title: State Opera Plovdiv: The Nutcracker Ballet Matinee
signals.location: Boris Hristov House of Culture, Plovdiv
signals.reason: A daytime holiday fairy tale ballet performance featuring festive music and visual choreography well-suited for introducing a 4-year-old to the stage.

signals.title: Regional Natural History Museum Plovdiv
signals.reason: A proven family favorite featuring an impressive live aquarium, terrarium, dinosaur displays, and a digital planetarium in a warm indoor setting.

signals.title: Aviation Museum Krumovo
signals.reason: A quick 15-minute drive from Plovdiv offering an expansive outdoor field where toddlers can run safely while inspecting real fighter jets and helicopters.

signals.title: Eco Park Stamboliyski
signals.reason: An exceptional suburban park specifically built for children with massive, creative wooden playgrounds, swings, and fenced running space.

signals.title: Ryanair Launches New Direct Route from Plovdiv Airport to Malta
signals.reason: Direct international air link twice weekly (Mondays and Fridays) operating directly out of Plovdiv without the friction of driving to Sofia Airport.

signals.title: Matchday Crowd & Traffic Disruption: Botev Plovdiv vs. CSKA Sofia
signals.reason: High-profile First League fixture expected to bring heavy police cordons, major road congestion, and parking restrictions across Kamenitsa and Iztok districts.

signals.title: PlovDev 2026 Tech & Software Conference
signals.reason: Annual premier regional software and technology conference; tech talks and development topics align with an FT/Economist media diet. Slides and code are in English; some presentation narrative in Bulgarian.

signals.title: Exhibition: 'Significant Plovdiv Artists – The Power of Vision'
signals.when_text: Running from Friday, 13 November 2026 to 10 January 2027
signals.location: Kapana Gallery (City Art Gallery), ul. 'Rayko Daskalov' 29, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Major curated retrospective exploring generations of Plovdiv visual artists across painting, graphic art, sculpture, and installations. Entirely visual medium in central Kapana.

signals.title: Classical Recital: Mezzo-Soprano Svetlina Stoyanova & Stephen Hopkins
signals.location: Episcopal Basilica of Philippopolis, bul. 'Knyaginya Maria Luiza' 2, Plovdiv
signals.reason: Chamber vocal recital by acclaimed Bulgarian mezzo-soprano (Vienna State Opera, La Scala) accompanied by Vienna State Opera's pianist, performed among Roman floor mosaics.

signals.title: Opening of 'Christmas in Plovdiv' Village & Open-Air Ice Rink
signals.reason: The city launches its winter market on the central square featuring artisan food stalls, an open-air ice rink, and a two-story carousel. Easy open-air stroll without language demands.

signals.title: Potochkine (FR) and snakeatsnake (BG) Live Underground Synth/EBM
signals.location: Bee Bop Café, ul. 'William Gladstone' 1, Plovdiv
signals.reason: French dark synth-punk duo paired with Bulgarian EBM artist for live electronic performance; strongly fits synthwave/post-punk tastes and requires no spoken Bulgarian.

signals.title: LUCKY House of Cinema: Subtitled Original Audio Screenings
signals.location: LUCKY Дом на киното, ul. 'William Gladstone' 1, Plovdiv
signals.reason: The city's primary independent cinema venue dedicated to international film festival selections and European cinema in original language audio with subtitles rather than Bulgarian dubbing.
